source: Direct user clarification relayed by root: output tokens need not match; early outputs reasonably correct, later objective benchmark no material regression.
applies_to: All future GLM optimization acceptance and interpretation of live648 outcomes

acceptance.early: Outputs finite, basic responses reasonable/correct, healthy memory/ownership/runtime.
acceptance.later: Actual objective benchmark paired OFF/ON, e.g.GSM8K/MMLU with explicit dataset split/revision/sample count/scoring/CI and no material quality drop; real varied request EOS service metrics. Thresholds must be explicit, not invented from exact-token agreement.
acceptance.token_exactness: Optional numerical localization diagnostic only; differing tokens are not by themselves a model quality failure or a reason to discard performance work.
acceptance.hardware_safety: Retain finite checks/canaries/read-only inputs, ABI/provider/owner/lifetime checks, valid output token range; do not remove memory safety.

live648.state: Original immutableharness includes older exact-gold assertions; no hot edit/injection.
live648.if_exact_assertion_fails: Preserve original record; label old strict differential interrupted measurement. Do not claim model incorrect; use actual benchmark next load.
live648.postbenchmark_entry: None safe; run_cohorts returns directly to model_destroy/shutdown; feedback transport is not new-prompt serving API.
live648.next_load_design: Keep one same-worker ctx/weights resident through quality benchmarks and varied request timing; no concurrent independent process assumes access to this ctx.
